articles.title: CtrlS to invest Rs 10,000 cr to set up 150 MW data centre
articles.summary: CtrlS Datacenters has announced an investment of Rs 10,000 crore to build a 150 MW AI facility. This facility aims to commence commercial operations by the year 2029-30 in Bihar.
